Project Architect
														
																
																			Selldorf Architects
																												
																	
								Employer:
												New York, NY, USLocation:
						Tue, Nov 10 '26Posted on:
													
																	$85,000 - $102,000																annually									
							
							Pay:
						                        
					 
				 
				
Selldorf Architects is seeking an experienced, technically proficient, and design-focused Project Architect to join our New York studio. This position is suited for an architectural professional with approximately 8 or more years of experience who is ready to take a leadership role in the technical development, coordination, and execution of complex architectural projects while working closely with Project Managers and Partners.
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong design sensibility, technical expertise, sound judgment, and excellent organizational, communication, and leadership skills. They will be responsible for overseeing the development and coordination of construction documents, managing construction administration activities, and guiding the day-to-day work of architectural staff. They should be comfortable leading technical and consultant coordination, anticipating and resolving project challenges, mentoring junior team members, and collaborating within a creative and rigorous studio environment while maintaining Selldorf Architects' high standards for design and technical excellence.
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: (OTHERS MAY BE ASSIGNED)
Design
- Interprets design objectives, in coordination with the Project Manager and Partner-in-charge and translates them into workable construction systems; maintains quality technical and design control.
Management:
- Supervises and mentors assigned staff in Selldorf Architect’s established techniques and standards to prepare Construction Documents, presentation drawings, architectural models, and project documentation
  
- Works closely with the Project Manager to ensure the project team is adhering to schedule.
- Communicates regularly with consultants and team members to ensure documents are coordinated; identifies issues that affect the design and works closely with the Project Manager to propose solutions.
Communication:
  
- Primary contact for Contractor and Consultant team
  
- Communicates with the client as directed by Project Manager on project details
  
- Prepares weekly project updates for the Client and the Principal, and the Partners
Documentation:
  
- Responsible for overseeing the preparation of design materials and construction documents throughout the design and construction phases of the projects 
  
- Responsible for ensuring that records of client/architect/consultant/contractor relationships and activities are maintained
Leadership:
  
- Actively contributes to firm-wide efforts to increase technical consistency and design efficiencies
  
- Guides and mentors architectural staff 
SUMMARY OF TASKS: (OTHERS MAY BE ASSIGNED)
- Participates in all aspects of Construction Administration, including site observation; manages contractor submittals and RFIs.
  
- Oversees the documentation production of the Department of Building Filing Set
  
- Conducts zoning and building regulation studies
  
- Determines project designs conform to building and zoning regulations.
  
- Directs and mentors architectural staff in the preparation of design and technical documents
  
- Prepares Meeting Minutes
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
  
  
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture required.
  
- 8+ years of architecture-related experience typical.
  
- Architectural License desired.  
  
- Must have solid conceptual and design process skills and good problem-solving abilities.
  
- Thorough knowledge of construction standards and codes, materials, and building systems.
  
- Experience using AutoCAD and REVIT is required.  Experience using 3-D modeling programs is desirable.  
  
- Ability to communicate via hand sketching is expected.
  
- Supervisory and management skills are required.  
  
- Demonstrated ability to effectively create presentations and communicate concepts to clients and associates using excellent drawing skills and various software applications.
  
- Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
  
- Ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
  
- Ability to complete tasks with accuracy and precision and with strong attention to detail.
  
- Ability to consistently meet deadlines, completing tasks as previously defined.
  
- Ability to work with integrity, trust, and commitment, setting an example for others.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS / WORK ENVIRONMENT:
- Ability to perform consistent work on PC.
  
- Occasional Domestic or International travel may be required.
  
- Ability to meet with clients on and off-site.
  
- Selldorf Architects follows      a hybrid work model based out of our New York City Union Square office,      with in-office presence required Monday through Thursday and the ability      to work remotely on Fridays.
 
BENEFITS, AND COMPENSATION
- The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $85,000–$102,000, commensurate with experience, qualifications, licensure, and demonstrated technical and project leadership capabilities. The position is also eligible for a discretionary quarterly performance bonus.
  
- The firm offers comprehensive medical benefits, a 401(k) match, paid vacation and personal time, and parental leave for eligible employees.
  
- Selldorf Architects is committed to fostering a collaborative, intellectually curious, and supportive studio environment where every team member has the opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to work of the highest design quality.
Selldorf Architects is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
If you would like to be considered for a position at Selldorf Architects, please e-mail your resume and portfolio as a single PDF, no larger than 10 mb to: [email protected] with the subject titled Project Architect
Phone calls or applications received by mail will not be accepted. All potential candidates must have legal work status in the United States. Selldorf Architects is an equal-opportunity employer.
